decision: The teacher-only GPU bridge passed four fixed development plan/logit/gradient checks, but did not demonstrate a useful end-to-end speedup on these cases. Leave the existing CPU full study uninterrupted. No TEST outputs influenced this operational decision.
limitations: Only two predetermined development cases per dataset, not a broad speed benchmark or whole-generator CPU/GPU identity proof.
Only fixed teacher forward/input gradients were offloaded. CPU graph construction and ranking remain; a full graph CUDA implementation was not tested.
No other GPU process was stopped or modified; transient shared-device slowdown was not measured.

launcher_parse_failure.reason: Initial remote source string had an unescaped newline and failed Python parsing before execution. Fixed locally; only one check job launched.
